# sophosfirewall_web_exception (Resource)

Manages a web filter exception (*Protect > Web > Exceptions*). Traffic that matches all configured `conditions` bypasses the checks selected in `skip`, e.g. HTTPS decryption for banking sites or malware scanning for a trusted update server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Do not decrypt or inspect online banking for the finance department.
resource "sophosfirewall_web_exception" "banking" {
  name        = "Finance-Banking"
  description = "No HTTPS decryption for banking sites"

  conditions = {
    web_categories  = ["Banking"]
    source_networks = ["10.10.20.0/24"]
  }

  skip = {
    https_decryption       = true
    certificate_validation = true
  }
}

# Let a trusted update server through without malware scanning.
resource "sophosfirewall_web_exception" "updates" {
  name = "Vendor-Updates"

  conditions = {
    url_regexes          = ["^([A-Za-z0-9.-]*\\.)?updates\\.example\\.com/"]
    destination_networks = ["203.0.113.0/24", "2001:db8:100::/48"]
  }

  skip = {
    malware_scanning    = true
    zero_day_protection = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `conditions` (Attributes) Traffic the exception applies to. At least one condition must be set. A request must match every condition that is set (AND) and any one entry within a condition (OR). Omitted conditions are switched off on the firewall. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions))
- `name` (String) Unique name of the web exception.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the exception is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `skip` (Attributes) Checks bypassed for matching traffic. Omit the block to skip nothing; the firewall's skip settings are then not tracked, so changes made elsewhere are not reported as drift. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--skip))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.

<a id="nestedatt--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions`

Optional:

- `destination_networks` (Set of String) Server (destination) IPv4 or IPv6 networks in CIDR notation, e.g. `192.0.2.0/24`, `2001:db8::/32`, or `192.0.2.10/32` for a single host. Omit to match any server address.
- `source_networks` (Set of String) Client (source) IPv4 or IPv6 networks in CIDR notation, e.g. `192.0.2.0/24`, `2001:db8::/32`, or `192.0.2.10/32` for a single host. Omit to match any client address.
- `url_regexes` (Set of String) Regular expressions matched against the request URL, e.g. `^([A-Za-z0-9.-]*\.)?example\.com/`. Omit to match any URL.
- `web_categories` (Set of String) Names of web categories, e.g. `Banking`. Omit to match any category.


<a id="nestedatt--skip"></a>
### Nested Schema for `skip`

Optional:

- `certificate_validation` (Boolean) Skip HTTPS certificate validation. Must be true when `https_decryption` is true. Defaults to `false`.
- `https_decryption` (Boolean) Skip HTTPS decryption. Defaults to `false`.
- `malware_scanning` (Boolean) Skip malware and content scanning. Defaults to `false`.
- `policy_check` (Boolean) Skip the web policy check, i.e. allow the request whatever the web policy says. Defaults to `false`.
- `zero_day_protection` (Boolean) Skip zero-day protection (Sandstorm) analysis. Defaults to `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name or UUID.
terraform import sophosfirewall_web_exception.example <name-or-uuid>
```
